title: fix(muya): preserve tight list block boundaries on save
issueTitle: [Bug] Saving a tight list whose item holds a code block reopens it as a loose list
why: The bug only shows after saving, closing and reopening the file. Reopening needs a file dialog or an app restart, and the visible result is extra vertical spacing between list items, not text that can be read on screen, so no exact expected text can be checked inside the editor.
